ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 80% low-intensity (black) pixels and 20% high-intensity (white) pixels primarily at distal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white regions with black speckling (mottling) at the lateral tips of both lobes; central fluke region is solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped depression with an approximate 45-degree angle; vertex base partially obscured by water splash/foam.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes between 5-20 pixels; numerous sharp peaks and V-shaped valleys along the entire trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory sweeping outward and upward towards the lateral fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme lateral tips and leading edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical high-intensity linear marks (scratches) visible on the distal white patch of the left fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization at distal tips; significant jagged serrations across the trailing edge indicating cumulative physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely dense concentration of barnacle structures at the furthest lateral margins of both lobes.
